page: Google Cloud Platform c4d-highmem-32 is an x86_64 architecture server instance within the c4d family. It features 32 dedicated virtual CPUs and 252.0 GB of system memory, yielding approximately 7.88 GB of RAM per core. This instance does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. Additionally, it does not provide any complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The hardware profile of the c4d-highmem-32 positions it as a memory-dense resource. The lack of local NVMe storage and GPU accelerators represents a clear tradeoff, reducing local I/O performance and parallel processing capabilities in exchange for a high memory-to-vCPU ratio. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, this configuration is optimized for workloads requiring substantial memory capacity without the added expense of specialized accelerator hardware or local solid-state drives.

Given its 32 dedicated vCPUs and 252.0 GB RAM, this server type is structured for memory-intensive applications. Suitable workloads include medium-sized databases, in-memory caching systems, enterprise applications, data analytics, and memory-heavy backend web serving.
